description: Human-governed repository topology for the Aftergraph polyrepo platform. This file defines scope and ownership classes, not exact Git state. Exact heads are generated from GitHub by scripts/org-state-verify.sh. architecture_plane carries one of the seven permanent semantic planes or null for support systems; system_class carries the functional repository class and is never inferred into a plane.

repositories.name: after-graph-governance
repositories.owns: Platform topology, cross-repo boundaries, contract registration and generated org-state mechanics.
repositories.must_not_own: Runtime authority, enforcement, execution, verification verdicts or any canonical domain truth owned by another repository.

repositories.name: aie
repositories.owns: Portable institution, authority, delegation, lifecycle, budget and revocation semantics.
repositories.must_not_own: Runtime enforcement, authenticated sessions and secrets, agent execution, durable WorkGraph state or independent verification.

repositories.name: trust-gateway
repositories.owns: Fail-closed runtime admission, policy enforcement, approvals, secrets and action audit.
repositories.must_not_own: Authority semantics, mission planning, durable work, organizational knowledge or independent verification.

repositories.name: runtime
repositories.owns: Agent lifecycle, orchestration, dispatch, checkpoints, metering and observability.
repositories.must_not_own: AIE authority, Trust Gateway enforcement, WORKS durable execution, organizational canonical knowledge or independent verification.

repositories.name: works-execution
repositories.owns: Durable work state, scheduling, workers, leases, recovery, execution evidence and quittance.
repositories.must_not_own: Agent persona, AIE authority semantics, Trust Gateway admission or independent verification.

repositories.name: relay
repositories.owns: Governed operator plane for supervising autonomous work across agents, missions, execution nodes, Runtime projection, and Aftergraph infrastructure.
repositories.must_not_own: Runtime authority, AIE semantics, Trust Gateway admission, WORKS durable execution, or independent verification verdicts.

repositories.name: studio
repositories.owns: General-purpose human operating environment for Chat, Work, Space, control and evidence surfaces.
repositories.must_not_own: Tenant binding, authority truth, execution truth, verification truth or world truth.

repositories.name: wi-backend
repositories.owns: Source-neutral observation to canonical WorkItem inference, review, publication and promotion boundaries.
repositories.must_not_own: AIE authority and delegation, Trust Gateway admission, agent lifecycle and orchestration, durable execution or independent verification.

repositories.name: wi-frontend
repositories.owns: Wie browser experience and least-privilege BFF consuming canonical Work Intelligence state from wi-backend.
repositories.must_not_own: Canonical WorkItem truth, which remains backend-owned, authority, admission, execution or verification.

repositories.name: context-continuity
repositories.owns: Portable transfer of actionable context/state across model, agent, session and runtime boundaries.
repositories.must_not_own: Authority grants, execution truth, verification verdicts or durable mission state.

repositories.name: continuum
repositories.owns: Continuity and containment fault-injection campaigns and verification harnesses.
repositories.must_not_own: Ordinary execution-outcome verification verdicts, ISR canonical metrics or ordinary session continuity ownership.

repositories.name: sentinel
repositories.owns: Exact-HEAD verified code-review verdicts with stale-base invalidation and cited evidence.
repositories.must_not_own: Execution of the work it verifies, authority semantics, enforcement or durable execution state.

repositories.name: sentinel-firetest
repositories.owns: Throwaway live-fire fixture for Sentinel proofs. Topology membership is temporary and grants no permanent platform responsibility.
repositories.must_not_own: Permanent platform responsibility, authority, enforcement, execution or verification semantics.

repositories.name: sentinel-firetest2
repositories.owns: Throwaway live-fire fixture for Sentinel proofs (second instance, live-verified 2026-09-10). Topology membership is temporary and grants no permanent platform responsibility.
repositories.must_not_own: Permanent platform responsibility, authority, enforcement, execution or verification semantics.

repositories.name: intelligence-systems-research
repositories.owns: SPEC-001, MISSION-Bench methodology, scientific claims, experiments, assurance and publication evidence.
repositories.must_not_own: Runtime authority, enforcement, execution or production platform behavior.

repositories.name: skills-vault
repositories.owns: Governed skill discovery, trust, lifecycle, provenance, compatibility and distribution.
repositories.must_not_own: Execution authority, admission decisions, verification verdicts or model lifecycle truth.

repositories.name: llm-research-development
repositories.owns: Reusable model research, experiment, evaluation, promotion and provenance methodology.
repositories.must_not_own: Model promotion and registry truth, production serving or execution authority.

repositories.name: afm
repositories.owns: AFM-specific model training, datasets, experiments, evaluations and artifact manifests.
repositories.must_not_own: Model registry lifecycle truth, production serving or platform authority.

repositories.name: model-registry
repositories.owns: Immutable promoted model identities, versions, aliases, lifecycle, provenance and artifact locations.
repositories.must_not_own: Model training and evaluation methodology, serving or execution authority.

repositories.name: autonomous-venture-company
repositories.owns: Legacy product, Hermes integration and migration-source behavior pending governed extraction.
repositories.must_not_own: New canonical Aftergraph platform responsibilities, new @avc/* contracts or new platform authority semantics.

repositories.name: aftergraph-cron-fabric
repositories.owns: Read-only scheduled organization sensing, evidence gating, dedupe and Telegram escalation. It grants no execution authority.
repositories.must_not_own: Execution authority, policy admission, verification verdicts or durable work state.

repositories.name: veranza
repositories.owns: Internal assurance-Product incubation concept under naming/clearance hold. Topology membership does not imply public or production maturity.
repositories.must_not_own: Public or production platform responsibilities, authority, enforcement, execution or verification semantics.

repositories.name: docs
repositories.owns: Provenance-pinned rendering, discovery, developer documentation and agent-readable context surfaces.
repositories.must_not_own: Upstream canonical truth; rendering and discovery only, never the source claim.

repositories.name: aftergraph.org
repositories.owns: Public website, marketing information architecture and system launcher.
repositories.must_not_own: Evidence upgrades, authority, execution or verification truth; visibility never upgrades evidence.

repositories.name: brand
repositories.owns: Visual identity, semantic design tokens, master assets and public communication design rules.
repositories.must_not_own: Runtime semantics, platform authority or execution behavior.

repositories.name: .github
repositories.owns: Organization profile, contribution defaults, security/support routing and shared community infrastructure.
repositories.must_not_own: Repository domain truth, authority, execution or verification semantics.

repositories.name: skill-abi
repositories.owns: Semantic compatibility, bounded effects, degradation and conformance for portable AI agent skills.
repositories.must_not_own: Skill discovery and distribution, execution authority, or evaluation methodology.

repositories.name: skillport
repositories.owns: Open benchmark and evaluation suite for semantic portability of skills across models, runtimes and capability environments.
repositories.must_not_own: Skill compatibility contract truth, model lifecycle truth, or execution authority.

repositories.name: business-ops
repositories.owns: Canonical tenant-neutral service-business domain state, invariants, migration mappings, charge-source facts and shadow-conformance semantics.
repositories.must_not_own: AIE authority, Trust admission/approval/secrets, Runtime orchestration, WORKS durable execution/evidence, Studio/Relay conversation/control experience, Billing invoice/payment truth, or independent verification.
